beats.say: William Contreras becomes only the seventh catcher ever to win World Series MVP.
He was named MVP on 29 October 2026.
But the real story started with a blockbuster trade.
He was traded to Milwaukee on 12 December 2022 in a three team deal.
That move put him on the path to catcher history, and he even signed with Air Jordan in 2024.
A trade that reshaped a career, now etched in World Series lore. Which catcher will join this exclusive club next?
